website.note: Pipeline rendered dynamically; details corroborated from 10-K and ClinicalTrials.gov.

pipeline.modality: Systemically administered oncolytic human adenovirus, tumor-selective replication, expressing PH20 hyaluronidase
pipeline.target: Tumor stromal hyaluronan (PH20-mediated degradation) plus oncolysis of tumor cells
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (acquired via Theriva Biologics S.L. / VCN Biosciences 2022)

indications.indication: First-line metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) in combination with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel
indications.trial_design: Randomized, open-label, multicenter Phase 2b of intravenous VCN-01 (two doses) plus gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel SoC vs SoC alone in newly diagnosed mPDAC; ~17 sites US/EU; 96-112 patients dosed
indications.trial_status: Phase 2b completed; positive topline May 2025; expanded results at ESMO Oct 2025; preparing pivotal Phase 3 (FDA End-of-Phase 2 meeting planned 1H 2026; CHMP Scientific Advice received Dec 2025)
key_milestones: Positive Phase 2b topline May 2025 (mOS 10.8 vs 8.6 mo, HR 0.57)
EMA/CHMP Additional Scientific Advice Dec 2025 supports single Phase 3

indications.trial_name: Investigator-sponsored Phase 1 intravitreal VCN-01 in retinoblastoma (Hospital Sant Joan de Deu, Barcelona)
indications.trial_design: Investigator-sponsored Phase 1 of two intravitreal injections of VCN-01 (2x10^9 or 2x10^10 vp/eye) in patients with intraocular retinoblastoma refractory to standard therapy; n=9
indications.trial_status: Phase 1 concluded with positive outcome (Apr 2024); FDA RPDD granted Jul 2024; EU Orphan designation Oct 2024; advancing toward US IND for adjunct therapy
indications.lead_sponsor: Hospital Sant Joan de Deu / Theriva Biologics SL
key_milestones: FDA Rare Pediatric Drug Designation Jul 2024
EU Orphan Medicinal Product Designation Oct 2024

indications.indication: Pancreatic and ovarian cancer (combination with huCART-meso)
indications.trial_name: huCART-meso + VCN-01 in pancreatic and ovarian cancer (UPenn-sponsored)
indications.trial_design: Investigator-initiated Phase 1 of intravenous VCN-01 with huCART-meso CAR-T cells in pancreatic and serous ovarian cancer
indications.lead_sponsor: University of Pennsylvania (Theriva collaborator; VCN-01 supplied by Theriva)

pipeline.target: Degrades excreted IV beta-lactam antibiotics in the upper GI tract

indications.indication: Prevention of acute graft-versus-host disease (aGVHD) and Clostridioides difficile infection in allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant recipients receiving IV beta-lactams
indications.trial_name: SYN-004 Safety and Tolerability in Allo-HCT Subjects
indications.trial_design: Phase 1b/2a safety, tolerability and PK study of oral SYN-004 in allogeneic HCT subjects receiving IV beta-lactam antibiotics; collaboration with Washington University
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting; company exploring out-licensing/partnering for SYN-004
key_milestones: Strategic review under way; non-core to oncology pivot

excluded_legacy_terminated: Earlier completed SYN-004 PK and Phase 2b CDI studies (NCT02419001, NCT02473640, NCT02563106)
Completed VCN-01 Phase 1 monotherapy/HNSCC studies (NCT02045589, NCT02045602, NCT03799744)
Completed SYN-020 Phase 1 PK studies (NCT04815993, NCT05045833) — SYN-020 licensed to Rasayana Feb 2026
excluded_partner_owned: SYN-020 (intestinal alkaline phosphatase) — licensed to Rasayana Feb 2026; no longer Theriva-led clinical program
